card.name: Ancient history dates and spans
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits or small linking words just before or inside an ancient-history year or time span, such as BC/BCE dates, early church dates, or 'for hundreds of years'.

modes.label: Inside ancient dates
modes.description: A space or digit right before or within a year in BC/BCE or early AD history.

modes.label: Linking word before a time span
modes.description: A small word like for, of, in, or by that leads into a duration or founding date in ancient history.
modes.example: the Etruscans had ruled over the Romans<< for>> hundreds of years.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a year or chapter number in a history or Bible passage.
